name: Mira
explanation: A young woman who knows the harbour by heart and never tires of the horizon.

name: Cevat
explanation: A lighthouse keeper of forty years. Says little, sees much.

name: Ravi
explanation: A stranger who wanders city to city, gathering stories.

name: Bahar
explanation: A clockmaker who mends time. Keeper of the glass garden.

name: The Shadow
explanation: A name the town tries to erase from its memory.

name: The Lighthouse
explanation: The fixed point around which the stories turn.
